record_body:
Account summary
- Northbridge Support is an existing Redwood customer using Hosted API + Optimize for customer support workflows (summarization + agent assist). They’ve been cost-sensitive and aggressive about enabling Optimize recommendations.
- History: escalated quality regression after applying an Optimize-driven quantization profile change (structured output drift + tool-call argument formatting). This account is one of the internal motivators for the Optimize quality guardrails gating work.

Current footprint (as of Feb 2026)
- Products in use: Hosted API (chat + embeddings) + Optimize (batching/caching + occasional quant profile proposals).
- Deployment preference: VPC deployment for production traffic. They are evaluating a Dedicated pool for predictable throughput + isolation once guardrails are default-on.
- Workload mix: 
  - Chat: agent assist with tool calling (tickets lookup, macro suggestions)
  - Summarization: post-call / case summary generation
  - Doc search: embeddings for KB articles (moderate volume)

Key requirements / buying signals
- Quality guardrails: wants gating to be mandatory for any Optimize apply that changes batching/caching/quantization/routing. Quote from follow-up call: “We’ll take fewer auto-savings if it means we never ship a silent quality drop again.”
- Structured output sensitivity: they rely on JSON schemas for tool calling; regressions are often “valid English but invalid JSON / wrong field names / extra prose”.
- Latency target: p95 < ~900ms on primary agent-assist routes; they will accept higher latency for offline summarization.
- Auditability: needs clear audit log trail proving eval checks ran before config changes, including suite/version/prompt-set revision and pass/fail reasons (this came up again in SUP-18544).
- Override posture: they want a break-glass override for high-priority incidents, but only with (1) restricted roles, (2) justification, (3) second approver if possible, and (4) prominent audit logging.
- Timeout behavior: they were confused by “timeout” UI state during early pilot discussions; wants deterministic messaging + guidance on retry vs block vs manual approval.

Notable risks / sensitivities
- Past regression blast radius: their tool-calling route is customer-visible and drives agent productivity; even small formatting drift creates downstream failures.
- Wants guardrails to distinguish between “rubric score shift” vs “hard formatting violation”. They prefer hard constraints (schema validity, tool-call parse success) to be treated as blocking regardless of small score deltas.

Activity timeline (recent)
- 2025-09-06 — Support escalation opened: Optimize apply → quality regression (quantization profile). Linked: SUP-18422. Internal notes mention “formatting drift” and “reasoning degradation on edge-case tickets”.
- 2025-09-08 — Triage call w/ Support + SE. Customer asked for: (a) rollback knob, (b) preflight evals, (c) report explaining what changed.
- 2025-10-01 — Redwood proposed early guardrails direction: eval-gated applies + audit logs. Customer responded positively but asked about runtime impact and ability to pin model/config.
- 2025-12-11 — Security/compliance review touchpoint: audit logging retention + export requirements. Linked Fireflies: ff_73aa10_security-review-guardrails-and-audit-logs.
- 2026-01-19 — Customer raised questions about gating “timeout” and whether applies are blocked if eval infra is down. Linked: SUP-18503 (messaging + reliability concerns).
- 2026-02-12 — Guardrails follow-up call: align on pilot scope and what “pass” means for their structured output routes. Linked: ff_nb_2026-02-12_guardrails-followup.
- 2026-02-21 — CSM check-in: customer willing to be a design partner for gating rollout if we provide (1) observe-only first, (2) weekly readout, (3) clear override process.

Open items / next steps
- Redwood to send: customer-facing outline of how guardrails gating works (incl. timeout behavior and safe-degrade policy) + draft audit event fields relevant to them.
- Northbridge to provide: sanitized prompt set samples for tool calling + structured output validation cases (they asked for a template; shared nb_prompt_set_template_v3.csv).
- Pilot proposal: enable observe-only gating on their tenant for Optimize applies (no blocking), run suites on top 3 recommendations (1x batching, 1x caching, 1x quant profile) and review deltas + CI stability.
- Commercial: expansion discussion to Dedicated capacity contingent on guardrails being available + documented; target close April 2026 if pilot is clean.

Internal notes (AE/CSM)
- This is a “trust recovery” account. They are not anti-Optimize; they are anti-automation without proofs.
- If we can demonstrate: (a) hard-block on schema/tool-call regressions, (b) strong audit trail, and (c) predictable retry/timeout behavior, they’ll be a strong reference for guardrails.
- Recommend involving Applied ML early to tune thresholds for their structured-output constraints (not just rubric scores).
